programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 12: Salvador Olvida, Charo Quiere Venganza
programme.desc: Socorro se da cuenta de que Salvador la escuchó al otro lado de la línea, cuando antes de que él cuelgue, escucha su voz diciéndole que él no tiene nada que ver con el bebé que ella desea.elipe le sugiere visitar a un ginecólogo para que se haga una inseminación artificial. Ella acepta. Charo se da cuenta de que Julio César le es infiel a Josefina con Isabel. Planea entonces enviarle un mensaje a Socorro para que se entere y sufra por el acto de su padre.Salvador sale por fin del hospital y regresa a su casa. Los golpes que recibió le han ocasionado problemas de memoria. Ha olvidado muchas palabras, pero por el momento no pareciera ser nada de gravedad.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 12: El Amor, La Herencia y El Viaje
programme.desc: Marisela se refugia en el consuelo de Jesús quien le presta su apoyo y su cercanía al tener el convencimiento de poder conseguir el amor de la muchacha, Marisela por su parte se mantiene leal a su amor por Gabriel al no dejarse seducir ni involucrar por las dulces palabras de los hombres que la pretenden. En la oficina Isadora lleva a cabo su encuentro con Alfonso quien se encarga de informarla respecto a sus condiciones para seguir manteniendo oculto el verdadero testamento dejado por Laura para beneficiar a Marisela con su herencia. Ignacio informa a Gabriel de su regalo de graduación logrando sorprender al muchacho con la noticia de su viaje para llevar a cabo su especialización.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 55: Sospechas, Despedidas y Secretos Revelados
programme.desc: A Luis Fernando es evidente que le afecto mucho el divorcio de sus padres, esta en la oficina muy molesto por algo Tatiana trata de calmarlo pero nada el no escucha. Mientras Dileidi piensa que su novio es distinto a todos los hombres el no será como el papá de su ahijada o sea la hija de Yenilu quien cumplía años ese día, al rato se encuentran en un café y allí sigue Luis Fernando con el mismo mal humor, Dileidi entiende pues el luego le cuenta lo que le esta pasando. Entre tanto, Rómulo se va a un bar con María José se les unen luego Eglee y Rosa, se ponen a recordar los momentos vividos durante su matrimonio, ya están algo pasados de tragos, María José y Rosa se retiran dejándolos solos, Rómulo le recuerda si todavía existirá un hotel al que ellos iban cuando eran novios, pues resulta que si y allí estuvieron una vez mas, Rómulo trata de tocar el tema de su separación y Eglee se lo impide, el entiende que ahí ya no hay mas nada que hacer, todo termino. En la casa de Pascuita se esta preparando todo para la despedida de soltera de la Nena, cuando llega Eglee todas se hacen solidarias con ella, la tratan de consolar, bromean y luego comienza la celebración en si o se la de la Nena. Gladis esta muy emocionada pues ese es su primer día de clase con su hijo Gerson, se lo comenta a su jefe y le pide permiso para irse temprano. Quien esta que se vuelve loca es Betzaida no sabe donde esta Rómulo, en la oficina sus compañeros bromean con que Rómulo y Eglee no se divorciaron, si supiera la pobre. Dileidi le comenta a su amiga que su novio le tiene alergia al matrimonio, Yenilu no puede creer que su amiga tan madura, vaya a pensar que ese muchacho se quiera casar con ella. Aureliano va a donde trabajan las muchachas y que a comprar el periódico, lleva a Cristina de parrillera, Dileidi se queda sorprendida cuando la ve, Cristina aún mas, le gusta mucho el muchacho pero quien lo iba a decir es amigo de la hija de la cachifa, que tal. Las que andan vueltas locas pues aún no saben con quien fue que Luis Fernando se fue para la playa son la Tatiana y la Felicita, no hayan que hacer ni que inventar para poder descubrir el personaje, Alegría que las escucha les da varias ideas entre ellas la de que se hagan pasar por embarazadas, a Felicita le parece que es buena idea, pero las cuentas no cuadran así que esa idea no la van a poder poner en practica. Llega Rómulo con las alas rotas al garaje, no puede ocultar su pena, solo piensa en Eglee y en los momentos maravillosos que vivieron durante todo ese tiempo que estuvieron casados, aunque ella no lo reconozca, ellos lo entienden y están claros que les gustaría que les pasara algo así. A Theo también le hacen una fiesta de despedida de soltero, en la bodega de Gabriel, aunque a su amigo no le guste mucho el fin por el que se esta casando Theo igual le da su apoyo y le desea lo mejor, llega en ese momento Gladis con sus cuadernos a buscar a Gerson pues tiene que irse para la clase, al enterarse que celebran por el matrimonio de Theo se ríe, pues ella si sabe lo que les espera a ese par. Cuando Gladis llega al colegio junto a su hijo, esta muy emocionada, Gerson por su parte no muestra ninguna emoción ni interés por superarse, su mamá no lo puede creer, trata de tomar nota de la clase pero se le hace imposible esta pensando que esta de nuevo retomando lo que alguna vez hace mucho tiempo tuvo que abandonar por causa de un embarazo, cuenta que con los apuntes de su hijo se pondrá al día, pero que va Gerson lo que esta es dibujando. En la Universidad Luis Fernando habla con Dileidi le dice que según el ya tienen tiempo como para que el ya conozca a su mamá, Dileidi se niega a dar ese paso, pues esta segura que cuando el se entere de su verdadera procedencia, que es pobre y que vive en un barrio, que su mamá es la cachifa de su casa, seguro que le deja el pelero, no que va le evade de nuevo, será para otro día. Cuando esta en la casa con su mamá Gladis le esta contando como le fue en su primer día de clase, le cuenta lo mismo que le dijo Yenilu que tuvo que dejar de estudiar por la misma causa, un embarazo, Dileidi se marea y su mamá lo nota, de inmediato se va al cuarto y busca un calendario, se da cuenta de que ya paso un mes desde que estuvo con Luis Fernando en la playa, continua sacando cuentas y nada se da cuenta que su menstruación no le ha venido, sospecha que pudiera estar embarazada.

programme.title: Las Amazonas
programme.desc: Emiro Lizárraga es un ambicioso y orgulloso propietario de un rancho de caballos llamado Amazonas. Emiro obtuvo su fortuna por medios ilegales, y tiene tres hijas Isabel, Carolina y Eloísa, además de haberse casado recientemente con su secretaria Elvira, una mujer coqueta, calculadora y ambiciosa. Las niñas no se llevan bien con la nueva esposa de su padre, lo que provoca conflictos. Isabel, la hija mayor, se siente atraída por Rodrigo, un joven veterinario divorciado y con dos hijas

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Inmaculada quiere saber si Neta es en realidad su hija. Para eso, quiere comparar las huellas de los pies de esa niña con las huellas de Victoria. Jeremías no está de acuerdo con que involucre a Alejandro en esto. Sin embargo, ella no le hace caso e igualmente le pide ayuda. Abril sigue insistiendo en divorciarse de Alejandro. Él, por su parte, no quiere hacerlo ya que se niega a que su hijo sea criado ya sea por Emanuel o por otro hombre. Por eso, le pide por favor a Abril que recapacite sobre la situación y lo perdone. Josue les cuenta a sus padres que va a casarse con Ruth. Aunque ellos se opongan, él no va a dar marcha atrás con sus planes, a pesar de que Ivana amenaza con hacerles la vida imposible.

Emiro obtuvo su fortuna por medios ilegales, y tiene tres hijas Isabel, Carolina y Eloísa, además de haberse casado recientemente con su secretaria Elvira, una mujer coqueta, calculadora y ambiciosa. Las niñas no se llevan bien con la nueva esposa de su padre, lo que provoca conflictos. Isabel, la hija mayor, se siente atraída por Rodrigo, un joven veterinario divorciado y con dos hijas

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Inmaculada quiere saber si Neta es en realidad su hija. Para eso, quiere comparar las huellas de los pies de esa niña con las huellas de Victoria. Jeremías no está de acuerdo con que involucre a Alejandro en esto. Sin embargo, ella no le hace caso e igualmente le pide ayuda. Abril sigue insistiendo en divorciarse de Alejandro. Él, por su parte, no quiere hacerlo ya que se niega a que su hijo sea criado ya sea por Emanuel o por otro hombre. Por eso, le pide por favor a Abril que recapacite sobre la situación y lo perdone. Josue les cuenta a sus padres que va a casarse con Ruth. Aunque ellos se opongan, él no va a dar marcha atrás con sus planes, a pesar de que Ivana amenaza con hacerles la vida imposible.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 12: Salvador Olvida, Charo Quiere Venganza
programme.desc: Socorro se da cuenta de que Salvador la escuchó al otro lado de la línea, cuando antes de que él cuelgue, escucha su voz diciéndole que él no tiene nada que ver con el bebé que ella desea.elipe le sugiere visitar a un ginecólogo para que se haga una inseminación artificial. Ella acepta. Charo se da cuenta de que Julio César le es infiel a Josefina con Isabel. Planea entonces enviarle un mensaje a Socorro para que se entere y sufra por el acto de su padre.Salvador sale por fin del hospital y regresa a su casa. Los golpes que recibió le han ocasionado problemas de memoria. Ha olvidado muchas palabras, pero por el momento no pareciera ser nada de gravedad.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 12: El Amor, La Herencia y El Viaje
programme.desc: Marisela se refugia en el consuelo de Jesús quien le presta su apoyo y su cercanía al tener el convencimiento de poder conseguir el amor de la muchacha, Marisela por su parte se mantiene leal a su amor por Gabriel al no dejarse seducir ni involucrar por las dulces palabras de los hombres que la pretenden. En la oficina Isadora lleva a cabo su encuentro con Alfonso quien se encarga de informarla respecto a sus condiciones para seguir manteniendo oculto el verdadero testamento dejado por Laura para beneficiar a Marisela con su herencia. Ignacio informa a Gabriel de su regalo de graduación logrando sorprender al muchacho con la noticia de su viaje para llevar a cabo su especialización.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 55: Sospechas, Despedidas y Secretos Revelados
programme.desc: A Luis Fernando es evidente que le afecto mucho el divorcio de sus padres, esta en la oficina muy molesto por algo Tatiana trata de calmarlo pero nada el no escucha. Mientras Dileidi piensa que su novio es distinto a todos los hombres el no será como el papá de su ahijada o sea la hija de Yenilu quien cumplía años ese día, al rato se encuentran en un café y allí sigue Luis Fernando con el mismo mal humor, Dileidi entiende pues el luego le cuenta lo que le esta pasando. Entre tanto, Rómulo se va a un bar con María José se les unen luego Eglee y Rosa, se ponen a recordar los momentos vividos durante su matrimonio, ya están algo pasados de tragos, María José y Rosa se retiran dejándolos solos, Rómulo le recuerda si todavía existirá un hotel al que ellos iban cuando eran novios, pues resulta que si y allí estuvieron una vez mas, Rómulo trata de tocar el tema de su separación y Eglee se lo impide, el entiende que ahí ya no hay mas nada que hacer, todo termino. En la casa de Pascuita se esta preparando todo para la despedida de soltera de la Nena, cuando llega Eglee todas se hacen solidarias con ella, la tratan de consolar, bromean y luego comienza la celebración en si o se la de la Nena. Gladis esta muy emocionada pues ese es su primer día de clase con su hijo Gerson, se lo comenta a su jefe y le pide permiso para irse temprano. Quien esta que se vuelve loca es Betzaida no sabe donde esta Rómulo, en la oficina sus compañeros bromean con que Rómulo y Eglee no se divorciaron, si supiera la pobre. Dileidi le comenta a su amiga que su novio le tiene alergia al matrimonio, Yenilu no puede creer que su amiga tan madura, vaya a pensar que ese muchacho se quiera casar con ella. Aureliano va a donde trabajan las muchachas y que a comprar el periódico, lleva a Cristina de parrillera, Dileidi se queda sorprendida cuando la ve, Cristina aún mas, le gusta mucho el muchacho pero quien lo iba a decir es amigo de la hija de la cachifa, que tal. Las que andan vueltas locas pues aún no saben con quien fue que Luis Fernando se fue para la playa son la Tatiana y la Felicita, no hayan que hacer ni que inventar para poder descubrir el personaje, Alegría que las escucha les da varias ideas entre ellas la de que se hagan pasar por embarazadas, a Felicita le parece que es buena idea, pero las cuentas no cuadran así que esa idea no la van a poder poner en practica. Llega Rómulo con las alas rotas al garaje, no puede ocultar su pena, solo piensa en Eglee y en los momentos maravillosos que vivieron durante todo ese tiempo que estuvieron casados, aunque ella no lo reconozca, ellos lo entienden y están claros que les gustaría que les pasara algo así. A Theo también le hacen una fiesta de despedida de soltero, en la bodega de Gabriel, aunque a su amigo no le guste mucho el fin por el que se esta casando Theo igual le da su apoyo y le desea lo mejor, llega en ese momento Gladis con sus cuadernos a buscar a Gerson pues tiene que irse para la clase, al enterarse que celebran por el matrimonio de Theo se ríe, pues ella si sabe lo que les espera a ese par. Cuando Gladis llega al colegio junto a su hijo, esta muy emocionada, Gerson por su parte no muestra ninguna emoción ni interés por superarse, su mamá no lo puede creer, trata de tomar nota de la clase pero se le hace imposible esta pensando que esta de nuevo retomando lo que alguna vez hace mucho tiempo tuvo que abandonar por causa de un embarazo, cuenta que con los apuntes de su hijo se pondrá al día, pero que va Gerson lo que esta es dibujando. En la Universidad Luis Fernando habla con Dileidi le dice que según el ya tienen tiempo como para que el ya conozca a su mamá, Dileidi se niega a dar ese paso, pues esta segura que cuando el se entere de su verdadera procedencia, que es pobre y que vive en un barrio, que su mamá es la cachifa de su casa, seguro que le deja el pelero, no que va le evade de nuevo, será para otro día. Cuando esta en la casa con su mamá Gladis le esta contando como le fue en su primer día de clase, le cuenta lo mismo que le dijo Yenilu que tuvo que dejar de estudiar por la misma causa, un embarazo, Dileidi se marea y su mamá lo nota, de inmediato se va al cuarto y busca un calendario, se da cuenta de que ya paso un mes desde que estuvo con Luis Fernando en la playa, continua sacando cuentas y nada se da cuenta que su menstruación no le ha venido, sospecha que pudiera estar embarazada.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Alejandro atrapa a dos chicas y dos chicos vestidos de Viuda Negra, de los cuales queda uno solo porque los otros logran escapar. Más tarde ve a la verdadera Viuda Negra en un carro pero no la logra atrapar. Al chico que atrapó se lo lleva a Inmaculada, la cual niega conocerlo, y luego a la unidad de homicidios a declarar. Allí Vanesa lo quiere meter preso y es ahí cuando el muchacho se asusta y quiere contar algo con tal de que no lo encarcelen. Josué le cuenta a su mamá que se va a casar con Pelusa y esta noticia a Ivana no le gusta nada y dice que si se casa les va a hacer la vida imposible. Josué piensa en alquilar un apartamento y es ahí cuando Pelusa pone la condición de que Domingo viva con ellos.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 13: Socorro: La herencia y la traicion.
programme.desc: Salvador le cuenta a Manuel lo que escucho sobre Socorro: que va a tener un hijo para ayudarle a su familia con el dinero que recibirá de la herencia. Julio César, desesperado con todos sus problemas, toma un arma para quitarse la vida. Josefina llega en ese preciso instante y lo detiene, pero la bala alcanza a impactar contra la pared. Socorro debe aplicarse un gel que le garantiza buenos resultados el día de la inseminación, pero le molesta hacerlo porque le arde la piel, Felipe la sigue convenciendo de que lo haga.Victoria llama a Salvador para encontrarse con él. Salvador acepta sin saber que ella es la esposa de Don Carlos.Charo le escribe un mensaje a Socorro sin revelar su identidad donde le confirma que su padre y su mejor amiga son amantes. Coco queda en shock.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Rural Japan: Tony decides to look for a more relaxing, traditional Japanese culinary experience in the countryside. Tony travels to an old-style Japanese inn that specializes in kaiseki cuisine, ancient tea ceremony, and local ingredients.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Cobra Heart-Food That Makes You Manly
programme.desc: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam: After taking a cyclo-ride through Ho Chi Minh City and trying various foods from roadside vendors and markets, Tony tests his might with a few shots of snake wine and a live cobra heart.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Anthony travels to Tokyo, where he begins in the Tsujiki market and then is introduced to techniques in preparing edomae sushi. He also learns the diets of Sumo wrestlers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Portugal: Portuguese cuisine holds a dear place in Tony's culinary heart. Tony travels to Porto, home of the famous Port wine, where he is immediately exposed to the codfish and the almost mythical place it holds in Portuguese cuisine and culture.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: No Beads, No Babes, No Bourbon Street
programme.desc: In New Orleans, Louisiana, Tony catches a Bayou alligator, cools off with a world-famous snow cone, gets in trouble with the law, eats jambalaya with a dancing chef, and relaxes to some local jazz.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Mekong River, Vietnam: On the river, Tony drinks a lot of Mekong moonshine with the welcoming owners of a duck farm. Although seduced by his Vietnam experience, Tony is not sure the royal dish Birds Nest Soup is all its cracked up to be.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Scotland: Beginning in Glasgow, Tony experiences the heart-clogging glory of deep fried pizza, deep fried mars bars, and deep fried pickled eggs! Moving on to more traditional fare, Tony tastes haggis and learns to hunt and fish for his food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Singapore: New York in Twenty Years
programme.desc: Tony sets out to find the real Singapore, with its multicultural restaurants and food markets. He samples prescription food dishes, explores the Geyland Serai Market, and rides the clean and efficient local subway.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Eating on the Edge of Nowhere
programme.desc: Cambodia and Japan: Taking his obsession with the film Apocalypse Now a little too seriously, Tony sets out for Pailin, reputed to be one of the most dangerous towns on earth. After his journey, Tony returns to Japan.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: The Struggle for the Soul of America
programme.desc: Tony travels to the grain-belt capital of Minneapolis, Minnesota to experience firsthand the conflict between creative independent operators and generic franchises.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: What is a Carioca? The natives of Rio de Janiero, Brazil are lovable scamps who find ways to avoid work, preferring the beach, flirting, and hanging out at restaurants and bars instead. Tony, under the tutelage of an exemplary Carioca, gives the lifestyle a try.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: No Beads, No Babes, No Bourbon Street
programme.desc: In New Orleans, Louisiana, Tony catches a Bayou alligator, cools off with a world-famous snow cone, gets in trouble with the law, eats jambalaya with a dancing chef, and relaxes to some local jazz.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: In the canon of Mexican tacos, the carnitas tacos has reached pinnacle. Golden, crispy pieces of pork nestled in a corn tortilla, coupled with a bracing squeeze of lime and a spoonful of creamy guacamole, represents pure taco perfection.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Essential features of the Mayan civilization are infused in the food, art, and architecture of modern Yucatan. Los Dos, a cooking school in Merida run by David Sterling, specializes in classic Mayan food updated for this century.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: "What is a taco, anyway?" muses Rick over an upscale lobster taco at Topolobampo. "Is it crispy or soft? Grilled or griddled? Street food or taqueria fare? Fast food or fine dining?" The answer is- "All of the above, and a whole lot more."

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: The Mercado Lazaro Cardenas is standard as far as markets in Mexico City go, but turn one corner, and you are in the world of coffee geeks, of which Rick is a proud citizen. Rick also meets with mixologists Joseph Mortera and Ricardo Nava.

programme.title: Backroads USA
programme.desc: Stretching from Chicago to Los Angeles, iconic Route 66 is a part of American legend and lore. Countless people have travelled along this historic roadway, celebrating the spirit of America, and the freedom of the open road. The beating heart of America can be felt as you glide along Route 66.

programme.title: Backroads Europe
programme.desc: Italy's Via Cassia once led north from Rome to Florence, finally joining the Via Aurelia at Luna (now Luni). As you meander northward along the ancient route, each unique location you visit, and the interesting people you meet there, speak vividly to the region's steeped history and culture.

programme.title: Mythical Roads
programme.sub-title: Papua New Guinea: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: There is a country where people live as if they are still in the Stone Age. It has been claimed that warrior cannibals, headhunters, and undiscovered tribes inhabit the terrain, and the country has long been the fantasy of every explorer. This country is Papua New Guinea.

programme.title: National Parks Revealed
programme.desc: Meet the people of America's national parks who help preserve our monuments and conserve our park's beauty. They rappel down the towering granite faces of Mount Rushmore, they execute prescribed burns in the Grand Canyon, and they plow the treacherous Going-to-the-Sun Road in Glacier National Park.

programme.title: Family Travel with Colleen Kelly
programme.desc: Colleen's family board the historic Skunk Train for a journey through the stunning Redwood Forests. They also learn the importance of environmental protection at the Solar Living Institute, take a canoe ride on Big River, and more.

programme.title: Family Travel with Colleen Kelly
programme.desc: Colleen's family learns about Atlantis' marine life, and Bahamian culture, in Nassau. They also cook local cuisine, assist on a sea turtle rescue, become educated on sea lion care, replant coral, and experience snorkeling at twilight.

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: Who was Gassy Jack and why was he so gassy? Why was Capilano Bridge built and what do all the totem poles mean? What do a train station, the Queen of England, and Harry Potter have to do with the Hotel Vancouver? Who was Yip Sang, and why did he have his own Boy Scout Troop?

programme.title: Travels with Darley
programme.desc: The historic Route 66 is alive with American history. Join Darley on a road trip from Chicago to St. Louis where the infamous road began to discover the places and stories peppered along the route. Step back in time along The Mother Road.

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: Why does a stone giant overlook Guanajuato? How did silver help shape this town? Why are the streets and alleys so winding? What happened to the Guanajuato River? What does the town's main church have to do with the King of Spain? Is there a Parisian influence in some of the architecture?

programme.title: Tastes Like Home
programme.desc: One thing Savina cannot find in Oregon is a traditional Irish breakfast. Thankfully for Savina, Jacinta has shared their family's secret recipes for making an Irish breakfast with Catherine, who travels to Oregon to surprise Savina.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Just when Terri thought she’d gotten over her ex boyfriend, Rick, he makes a concerted effort to win back her affections. She and her friends are wary – after all, leopards can’t change their spots.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Craig’s determined that he and the guys will be the “Last Band Standing” at Degrassi’s battle of the bands and win a spot on the show. So he sets the guys a fierce practice schedule and starts to write a killer new song.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: The year-end Junior Formal is fast approaching, and Marco is in charge, except when it comes to a date. Problem is, Marco’s too nervous to ask Dylan out at all, let alone ask him to the prom.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: A stressed-out Paige and Spinner decide they need a break and skip school for the day. Ashley, meanwhile, is in the doldrums, too “sick” to go to school. So when Ashley calls Paige to get her homework, Paige decides Ash needs to join them in a little fun.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: Once again, as things finally start to come together for Sean, the other shoe drops - his brother and guardian, Tracker, has found a new job in Alberta. Sean thinks his life is over until he finds out that he can legally live on his own.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: The year end semi-formal is only hours away and Marco has transformed the gym into an idealized Bombay. programme.sub-title: The Ghost In the Machine, Pt.1

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.sub-title: The Ghost In the Machine, Pt.2

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: Tiempo De Navidad
programme.desc: Dos hermanos separados intentan reconectarse en Navidad, pero hay algo que uno de ellos no puede superar: el otro cree que es un viajero en el tiempo.

programme.title: Mi Dulce Navidad
programme.desc: Sadie decide pasar la Navidad en su ciudad natal cuando descubre que sus padres están planeando vender la tienda de chocolate tradicional de su pequeña ciudad y poner en peligro sus sueños de infancia de heredarla.

programme.title: Un Sueño De Navidad
programme.desc: Martha, madre de tres hijos, es abandonada por su marido de la noche a la mañana. Entonces ella decide emprender una nueva vida con sus pequeños y se traslada a un pequeño pueblo para empezar de cero.

programme.title: Volviendo De La Luna De Miel
programme.desc: Cuando Zane y Jeannette regresan de su luna de miel se encuentran con un invitado inesperado esperándolos.

programme.title: Romance Navideño
programme.desc: Mandy, la dueña de una tienda de manualidades y pasatiempos, descubre una copia antigua de "A Christmas Carol" entre las donaciones para una campaña de donación de libros y juguetes. En el libro hay una carta a Papá Noel de hace 70 años y una moneda valiosa. Mandy se propone encontrar al dueño del libro, la carta y la moneda con la ayuda de Jonah, un contratista que lo encontró y donó el libro. En el camino, encuentran pistas que los acercan más al autor y el uno al otro, pero ¿puede Mandy devolverle todo al dueño del libro a tiempo para Navidad y hacer realidad su propio deseo navideño?

programme.title: Lasos Navideños
programme.desc: Liam, un bombero, y Amy, una profesora de acolchado, se unen para hacer una colcha de Navidad para la boda de la hermana de Liam. Mientras navegan por sus sentimientos mutuos, deben decidir qué es lo verdaderamente importante a tiempo para las fiestas navideñas.

programme.title: Salvando Santalandia
programme.desc: Cuando visita el hogar de su infancia, saltan chispas entre una famosa modelo y un granjero con una hija pequeña. El pueblo corre el riesgo de perder su querido festival de Santalandia, pero los milagros pueden ocurrir con un poco de amor, familia y fe.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When Baby Bop is surprised by the first day of cold weather, its Barney that helps her see that winter can be a wonderful time for fun. Baby Bop is getting discouraged, wondering if it will ever snow. Then, when she least expects itthe snow begins to fall! On a hot summer day, Barney teaches BJ about all the fun activities you can do during the summer. BJ gets so excited that he corrals Riff into joining him to do a whole summers worth of activities, all in one day! With some help from Baby Bop and the children, Barney teaches BJ that summer means relaxation, too!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Its a very special day at the Parkits Barneys birthday, and there are surprises around every corner. When Barney begins to open his presents, Riff worries that his hand-made gift wont be good enough. In the end, Barney loves Riffs gift and reminds everyone that the best gift of all is one that comes from the heart. Baby Bop is practicing her marching because she will be joining a real marching rhythm band and is having trouble keeping a beat. Barney, BJ and Riff help Baby Bop learn about rhythm just in time for her to join the band.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop has trouble following the rules and taking turns while playing games. Barney and Riff help her learn how to follow the rules and Baby Bop learns that rules make games fun for everyone! BJ hurts his toe while pretending to be Captain Pickles. When Barney suggests he rest in the caboose, BJ becomes frustrated, as hed rather be outside playing. Barney reminds him of the wonderful world of books, and the little dinos decide to write a book of their ownbased on the exciting true-life adventures of Captain Pickles!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJs enthusiastic efforts to decorate the park go awry when he accidentally paints the caboose several different colors. Barney helps BJ learn that everyone makes mistakes. Together with his friends, BJ cleans up the mess he made on the caboose. Baby Bop cant wait for BJ and Riff to go on their camping trip so she can have Barney and the park all to herself! But, once theyre gone, she discovers she misses them more than she expected and the more time that goes by, the more she misses them! Barney shows Baby Bop ways to keep friends close in our hearts while theyre away.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ, Baby Bop and Riff can hardly wait for the petting zoo that is coming to the park. Barney helps them pass the time while teaching them about the days of the week. When the animals finally do arrive, everyone realizes that it was all worth the wait! Riff feels terrible when he accidentally wrecks BJs beloved scooter. BJ loved that scooter more than almost anything! Riff and Baby Bop decide to have a sale in the park to raise money to buy BJ a brand-new scooter.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ is pretending to be a great detective, and needs a mystery to solve! A case quickly comes his way when something nibbles on one of Baby Bops healthy snacks. BJ, Barney, and Baby Bop uncover several clues along the way and soon realize the culprit is someones pet rabbit. Barney sees Riff protecting a nest full of duck eggs. Together, they leave the eggs to look for food for when the ducklings hatch. When they return, Riff is pleasantly surprised to find the eggs have cracked open and the baby ducklings have hatched!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: While playing in the caboose, BJ is surprised to learn that The Land of Mother Goose truly exists. Several Mother Goose characters have come to ask for help; parts of their rhymes are missing! Mother Goose arrives and fixes the problem, and all of the Mother Goose characters return home. BJ and Baby Bop hope to visit them soon. When Baby Bop catches Barney, BJ, Riff and some children wrapping a mysterious present in the caboose, she just cant wait to see what is in the box. Barney suggests they listen to a story while they wait. Baby Bop finally gets to open her present and realizes that sometimes waiting is a good thing!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Baby Bop isnt satisfied with the things she can do. She wants to play the keyboard like Riff and wants to be able to skate like Barney. Nobody can cheer her up, until she unexpectedly gets the whole park dancing and she realizes there are things she can do, too! When a wheelchair-bound child is unintentionally neglected by his friends, Barney steps in to help. He gently reminds the others to include the child by showing them that even Barney feels excluded sometimes. It isnt always easy being a big, purple dinosaur. In the end, everyone is included for a day of fun!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Jamal has never danced before and is too shy to try. On the day of the big dance party in the park, Barney and his friends introduce Jamal to many kinds of dance. Barney assures Jamal that he can do anything he puts his mind to even dance. With Barneys help, Jamal finally finds his groove and has fun dancing with his friends! Barney tells Baby Bop the story of The Princess Without a Song to Sing. In this original fairytale, Baby Bop imagines herself as the sad little princess trying to find her unique song. Barney, BJ and Riff all become characters in the story, each sharing their songs and revealing an element of song, sound, rhythm and feeling. With their help, the princess finds her song and is delighted to sing it for her friends!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Riff cant find his drumsticks anywhere. He knows he had them when he visited various neighborhood locations with Barney earlier in the day. Barney magically recreates neighborhood spots to help refresh Riffs memory. Happily, Barneys strategy is a success and Riff finds his drumsticks. Along the way, everyone learns that the most important part of a neighborhood is the people who live there! Barney helps Baby Bop explore many different jobs. At the end of the day, Baby Bop has several different careers to consider for when she grows up. But for now, shes happy just being three!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Three children try to build a pretend farm, but have a hard time working together. Barney takes them to a ranch to show them how all the people there have to work together to keep things running smoothly. Riff invents a Happiness Machine to try to cheer up a sad little girl. But it's her friends, not the machine, that make her happy!

programme.sub-title: For the Fun of It - Starlight, Star Bright
programme.desc: BJ wants to learn Terry's fancy basketball moves. He tries hard, but just can't seem to do it! More importantly, he's not even having fun anymore. After some advice from Barney and Terry, BJ has fun while doing his best! On a campout, Baby Bop sees a falling star and wants to return it to the sky. With a little imagination and help from Barney and friends, she replaces the star that fell.

programme.sub-title: Big as Barney - No, No, No!
programme.desc: Everyone loves Barney! When Ryan tries to be just like Barney, he has a hard time filling Barney's shoes. Ryan soon learns that he is special when he's just being himself! Baby Bop is having one of those days! Every time she turns around, someone is telling her no! As her frustration grows, Barney explains that the word no can help you avoid making mistakes or getting hurt.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: There's a fishing contest in the park! When Ryan is tempted not to follow the rules, Barney tells The Emperor's Contest and Ryan discovers that honesty is the best policy. When Riff meets a friend who can't hear well, Riff wonders if he would still like music. Barney tells everyone about Beethoven, a famous musician who wrote beautiful music even though he couldn't hear it.

programme.desc: Everyone is excited for Halloween tonight! Everyone knows what they're going to be for Halloween. BJ is going to be a pirate, Melanie is going to be a cat, David will be a superhero, and Baby Bop is going to be a ballerina princess. Everyone has decided on a costume all except for Riff. Barney tries to give Riff ideas on a costume like a sailor, a firefighter, or a dancer. Riff surprises everyone in the end by wearing a one-man band costume. Then, it's time for the Halloween party to begin! Barney and his friends have fun Trick-or-Treating in the park at night. But when Ramon loses all his Halloween candies, BJ shares his Halloween candies with him.

Barney's friends are having a hard time deciding what to do because everyone wants to do the same thing! Barney's Native American tale, The Chase, shows them that it's best to think for themselves and not follow the crowd.

programme.sub-title: Dream Big - Thats What A Mommy Is
programme.desc: After watching birds fly overhead, Riff begins to daydream of flying. He decides to build his very own rocket ship and fly to Mars. The flight is not exactly a success, but Barney encourages Riff to never give up on his dream. After seeing many moms playing with their kids in the park, Baby Bop is curious as to what makes somebody a mommy. With Barney's help, Baby Bop learns all about what makes mommies so special.

programme.desc: Baby Bop's blankey seems to be getting smaller; she's convinced it's shrinking. But Barney shows her that, actually, Baby Bop is growing. When Riff takes a bite of ice cream, he realizes has a very sore tooth. Afraid of going to the dentist, Barney and his friends put on a show to help Riff see there is nothing to be afraid of - the dentist is his friend.

programme.desc: Barney's friends transform the task of collecting litter pieces scattered across the park into an engaging game. programme.desc: The kids gather in the park for an exciting tea party they had planned, which begins with each of them showing each other the various ways they've contributed, from cookies to decorations. programme.desc: Mr. Boyd wanders around the park searching for his dog Bingo, who playfully hides in different areas of the park. programme.desc: Barney and his friends are so excited for a day of play and fun! When a bunch of empty boxes arrived from the Enjoy-Your-Toys Company, their adventure begins. They use their imagination to have the best time ever by transforming the boxes into special toys.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: After playing with Stop and Go signs with Angela, Baby Bop leaves to direct some traffic of her own. Barney and his friends think of other ways to stop and go and discuss reading, especially traffic signs!

programme.desc: Barney helps his friends put together a Caboose Color Collection which showcases the primary colorsred, yellow and blue. This activity sparks Barney and the kids' imagination, and along with Baby Bop, they realize just how colorful the world can be!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: The children are amazed to find out that playing games and having fun in the park is a great way to exercise. When the rain starts to fall, they use their imagination to come up with clever ways to stay active and have fun indoors.

programme.desc: Barney and the kids are full of excitement as five of Mr. Boyd's brass-playing friends are planning a special show in the park tonight! Angela is determined to learn the trumpet, but she finds it challenging. To help them get ready for the band's practice, Mr. Boyd introduces the children to various types of horns, making it a fun learning experience!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Meet Colleen, Mr. Boyd's niece! Barney and the kids love having fun together every day but making a brand NEW friend is something extra special! With Barney's help, they all learn how to get to know new friends.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Tony has a box filled with numbers that he made with his dad and is proudly showing them to everyone. Suddenly, a strong gust of wind scatters the numbers all around! Barney and his friends team up to go on an exciting number hunt, helping Tony find and collect his homemade numbers again.

programme.sub-title: This Way In! This Way Out!
programme.desc: Angela is in the park to release her turtle, Terry, after observing him with her classmates in school. Barney, Nick, and Sarah are delighted to see Terry come out of his shell, which leads to a discussion about the meanings of in and out. Baby Bop arrives with her chrysalis, and together with Angela's turtle, Barney and his friends are inspired to do In and Out activities.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: BJ is waiting for a very special letter from his pen pal in China. The letter reveals that his pen pal is coming for a visit. With the help of friends in the park, BJ hurries to get the park ready. He wants it decorated so his pen pal feels right at home. BJ soon learns that his pen pal wants to see how BJ really lives! Everyone is anxiously awaiting Mrs. Matumas Harambee Dance Troupe to arrive. They finally arrive and perform a show of African music and dance and everyone pulls together in the true spirit of Harambee!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: Barney is snacking on pistachios...and just can't seem to stop! His friends try to help. An unexpected avalanche of pistachios convinces Barney that his friends may be right. BJ is looking to find players for his baseball team. When his baseball-impaired cousin Riff asks to play, BJ is faced with a difficult choice. Barney helps BJ discover the meaning of team sports, friendships, and winning.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: In her eagerness to play with her friends, Baby Bop forgets to say please and thank you. Barney tells her that these two words can be magic. Baby Bop daydreams she can't say the magic words, no matter how hard she tries! Then Riff invents a robot to clean up the park. When Riff's Litterbot malfunctions, it creates even more trash to clean up.

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.desc: When Baby Bop becomes a little bossy playing with her friends, Barney teaches her that being bossy isn't a nice way to treat your friends. Melanie has never been on a campout and is feeling nervous. When Barney tells her all about the fun they will have, Melanie decides to give it a try. What could be better than sharing her very first campout with her friends and Barney?

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: Little Red Rockin Hood - The Whole Truth
programme.desc: Baby Bop is having a hard time finding a story she hasn't heard before. Barney and the dinos decide to tell her an old story with a new twist...by singing Little Red Riding Hood! A talented young artist is painting a portrait of Barney, but when she steps away, BJ takes credit for it. When the others beg him to teach them to paint, BJ admits the truth and learns that honesty is the best policy!

programme.title: Barney and Friends
programme.sub-title: The Wind and the Sun - The Nature of Things
programme.desc: Baby Bop sets up a lemonade stand, but BJ wants to fly his kite in the same spot, leading to a heated debate over sun vs. wind. Barney shares the story of The Wind and the Sun, teaching them that kindness always prevails. Rachel carelessly litters in the park. Later on, she has a dream about animals who talk. programme.title: All the Creatures Were Stirring
programme.desc: The joyful spirit of Christmas takes one dark turn after another -- from sadistic office parties and last-minute shopping nightmares to vengeful stalkers and immortal demons.

programme.title: The Sacrifice Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s, boarding school students Samantha and Clara stay behind during Christmas break. Things take a deadly turn when a murderous gang arrives at their doorstep, intent on summoning a demon.

programme.title: Creepshow
programme.desc: Mysterious symptoms lead Robert Weston to believe he might be a werewolf, but when he goes to a Shapeshifters Anonymous support group, he learns there's something far more sinister than his curse to worry about.

programme.title: Creepshow
programme.desc: Mysterious symptoms lead Robert Weston to believe he might be a werewolf, but when he goes to a Shapeshifters Anonymous support group, he learns there's something far more sinister than his curse to worry about.

programme.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
programme.desc: Holiday mayhem, including "Black Christmas," "Krampus," "Silent Night Deadly Night," "Terror Train," "My Bloody Valentine," "Mother's Day," "April Fool's Day," "Happy Death Day" and the 2018 "Halloween," featuring returning guest Jamie Lee Curtis.

programme.title: A Christmas Horror Story
programme.desc: Not even Santa Claus is safe from the evil that descends on Bailey Downs, a small town that is suddenly plagued with malevolent spirits, zombie elves and Krampus -- the anti-Santa Claus.

programme.title: Christmas Presence
programme.desc: A Christmas gathering between friends quickly becomes a violent fight for survival.

programme.title: The Advent Calendar
programme.desc: An ex-dancer is given a mysterious advent calendar.

programme.title: Bleed With Me
programme.desc: During a winter getaway at an isolated cabin, a self-destructive young woman becomes convinced that her best friend is stealing her blood.

programme.title: All the Creatures Were Stirring
programme.desc: The joyful spirit of Christmas takes one dark turn after another -- from sadistic office parties and last-minute shopping nightmares to vengeful stalkers and immortal demons.

programme.title: The Sacrifice Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s, boarding school students Samantha and Clara stay behind during Christmas break. Things take a deadly turn when a murderous gang arrives at their doorstep, intent on summoning a demon.

programme.title: Christmas Presence
programme.desc: A Christmas gathering between friends quickly becomes a violent fight for survival.

programme.title: I Trapped the Devil
programme.desc: Hoping for a joyful family reunion, Matt and his wife pay a surprise visit to the home of his estranged brother, Steve, to celebrate Christmas. To their shock, they soon learn that Steve has a hostage in his basement -- a man he claims is the devil.

programme.title: The Last Drive-In with Joe Bob Briggs: Joe Bob's Christmas Carnage
programme.desc: A Finnish archeological dig unearths a very dark Santa.

programme.title: ATM
programme.desc: A murderous assailant traps three people (Alice Eve, Josh Peck, Brian Geraghty) in a small kiosk containing an automatic teller machine.

programme.title: Fall Down Dead
programme.desc: A serial killer stalks seven strangers in an office building during a blackout.

programme.title: Fly Shop Tour
programme.desc: We kick off Season 2 in Tennessee where we stop in Nashville, Townsend, and Johnson City!!

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.sub-title: "Groups working to restore our vital ecosystems"
programme.desc: We highlight organizations and programs making a difference in the Florida Keys. Learn how they help protect and restore these vital ecosystems.

programme.title: Duck Camp Dinners
programme.desc: Similar to any good Cajun dish, a successful duck camp requires preparation. The last day on dry land is filled with essential stops to get ready for 5 days on the Bayou. Whether making sure we have the right ingredients for our favorite meals, or getting the boats brushed up and ready for action, the day before can be just as important as the day of.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: A remnant of the last Ice Age, the musk ox is almost mythical in appearance. For the people who share the Barren Ground region of Canada with them, they are an integral part of their culture. Show host, Dan Cabela, participates in a scientific sampling project to monitor the - population's health, and get first-hand experience of the relationship between local people and this arctic icon.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff dive into the wild waters off Hawaii’s coast, coming face-to-face with sharks and graceful manta rays. The adrenaline peaks when Kyle takes a heart-pounding leap off a towering 40-foot cliff, making this adventure as daring as it is unforgettable.

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.sub-title: "Oktoberfest in Helen Georgia and some Monster Trout"
programme.desc: Danny has got the gang back together. Ryan Sheffield and John McCune meet us in Helen Georgia for Oktoberfest and trout fishing on private waters.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: Host Ryan McVinney takes Boat Trader fans on an indepth exploration of Florida flats fishing deep in the backcountry of Islamorada. Featuring Captain Eric Lund, a Wall Street Broker turned backcountry fishing guide, this episode reveals the key design features of the world’s best flats skiffs and how they are built for targeting some of the most exciting sportfish species on the planet. Also, covered are bay boats and their versatility for families exploring Florida’s coastal waterways, along with a detailed study of fish species and wildlife in the region. Some of the area’s most beautiful and secret locales show why Islamorada has earned the nickname of the Sportfish Capital of The World.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Exploring New York City's Hidden Culinary Gems: Cooking Goat Brains, Lobster & MORE"
programme.desc: New. York. City. That’s where our host Josh Rosen kicks off his journey in Episode 4—and where he lived for 16 years and started up the surf-centric apparel brand, Saturdays NYC. Back in his old stomping grounds, Josh first meets up with the award-winning chef and Mumbai native, Chintan Pandya, currently blowing up the New York food scene with his unapologetic and authentic Indian cuisine (pro tip: try the goat brains). Next, Josh travels through the boroughs, heads upstate, and along the coast to source local ingredients—from sake brewers and pig farmers to catching fresh lobster just 100 miles from Wall Street. As always the adventure will end with a feast, right back in Chintan’s kitchen.

programme.title: Fishing With Jay
programme.sub-title: "Fly Fishing For Gag Grouper Ozello Keys"
programme.desc: We researched all we could about fly fishing for grouper. Nothing came up. Normally a deep water fish, in Ozello Florida you can find gags in just a few feet of water, hiding in cracks waiting to ambush anything that swims overhead. Watch and see what we discovered. #fishingwithjay

programme.title: Fishing With Jay
programme.sub-title: "Fly Fishing Giant Jacks in Stuart Florida"
programme.desc: Jay and Casey link up with Captain Mike Holiday to chase giant jacks off the beach. Casey got schooled last time, he's looking for redemption.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Join Captain Josh and Sheriff Eric Aden for a day of fishing and fun in Destin, Florida. These two friends hit the water, catching fish both offshore and inshore, and reeling in some impressive catches. With plenty of laughs, great stories, and a few surprises along the way, this episode is all about the joy of fishing and the bond between two guys who love the sea.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Denise Sanchez was awarded a hunt at G2 following our Hunters Extravaganza drawings. Its great to get to spend time on the ranch with new members of TTHA. Denise gets familiar with a giant and learns about new technology while on this hunt.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We love our college chapters. Hudson has been a long time member of TTHA as well as serving with the Texas A&M Chapter. We have a great time at G2 in pursuit of Axis deer.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Each year we get to spend time in camp with some of our best friends. Zach from Big & J gets some time in a blind while reflecting on what hunting in Texas means to him. Texas provides a wide variety of game, and chasing these creatures all across the state is some of the best times had.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: In 2010, Amberly Snyder’s life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you’d see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly’s story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Exploring New Zealand’s Wild Flavors, Māori Culture & Volcanic Hot Spring Cooking"
programme.desc: They say you come to New Zealand as a stranger, but leave as family. In this episode of DIRT, the crew goes full circle—meeting Muttonbird chefs Emma and George on the South Island before hopping up to Raglan and working their way back down. Water skiing next to snow-capped mountains, cooking in hot springs the Māori way, and stargazing at Wairarapa Dark Sky Reserve are all on the itinerary. But it’s the final “Feed” done Kiwi-style that makes one thing clear—in this unique and stunning land, nobody’s a stranger for long.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation

Despite significant revenue growth, Chad seeks investment due to cash flow challenges, primarily caused by delays in insurance reimbursements. The panel expresses concerns about profitability and the need for clearer communication about the company's mission.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.desc: Phil Fogarty, owner of PSA Security, discusses his business struggles and funding needs with Joe Camberato, CEO of National Business Capital. Phil's security company faced challenges during the COVID-19 pandemic but pivoted successfully to provide social distance monitoring services, leading to significant revenue growth. Despite increasing demand, cash flow constraints hinder further expansion. Phil emphasizes his motivation to succeed for his family and seeks guidance on refining his pitch and understanding financial metrics.

programme.title: Fund Tank
programme.sub-title: Fund Tank - Kids of Valor Academy

Mona shares her inspiring journey, highlighting her commitment to providing affordable childcare in urban areas, driven by her own experiences as a teen mother. She plans to expand her academy to seven locations and aims to create a safe haven for women leaving domestic violence situations. Mona discusses her revenue, profitability, and organizational structure, emphasizing her all-female management team and the positive impact she aims to make in her community.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Tall Tales
programme.desc: When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.

programme.title: Luis and the Aliens
programme.desc: A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

programme.title: Gil Scott-Heron - Black Wax
programme.desc: BLACK WAX is a musical-political entertainment film produced and directed by Robert Mugge. It centers on the late African American poet-singer-songwriter Gil Scott-Heron - the man Melody Maker called the most dangerous musician alive and many dubbed the forefather of rap music - and his Midnight Band.

programme.title: SPIN COVER STORY yungblud: "walk with me"
programme.desc: If Yungblud led a cult, many would join - even those who fancy themselves hard to persuade. He has an orbit, an aura, an affability that is borderline intoxicating. You can experience it for yourself during our walk with Yungblud through the Sunset Strip, from the Viper Room to the Rainbow Bar and Grill – watch Yungblud share some incredible stories and a Dr Pepper

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: LoudQUIETloud: A Film About the Pixies
programme.desc: loudQUIETloud follows the rehearsals and the warm-up shows for the full-fledged, sold-out Pixies reunion tour. It also catalogs, in the cinema-verite style of the Rolling Stones' Gimme Shelter, the less glamorous side of the touring band lifestyle, getting as close to this enigmatic act as anyone is ever likely to get. The Pixies have a once-in-a-lifetime chance at rock n roll redemption.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: From Amadeus the worlds first rockstar to The Beatles and Elvis, Hollywood has always remembered "When Rock Was Young"

programme.title: Until The Light Takes Us
programme.desc: Until The Light Takes Us tells the story of black metal. Part music scene and part cultural uprising, black metal rose to worldwide notoriety in the mid-nineties when a rash of suicides, murders, and church burnings accompanied the explosive artistic growth and output of a music scene that would forever redefine what heavy metal is and what it stands for.

programme.title: SPIN x Fire: Free Speech + Other Dirty Words
programme.desc: Hear Morello discuss his message and mission in Free Speech + Other Dirty Words, presented by SPIN and the FIRE, and hosted by Ryan Downey.

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.desc: Claudia recurre a su padre Steve en busca de ayuda cuando teme que la mayor venta de su carrera minera se le esté escapando de las manos.

programme.title: La Fiebre del Jade
programme.desc: Mover una enorme losa de jade pone a prueba el antiguo equipo de la mina y la paciencia de Josh.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando su esposo renuncia después de un reventón con Joe, Kelly se pone en una posición terrible. ¿Se quedará en Buffalo o se irá? Scott recibe la noticia de que debe retirarse del vuelo para que otro copiloto pueda acelerar el paso al capitán. Él hace todo lo posible para asegurar una nueva carta, pero su rival también quiere volar el nuevo trabajo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de la amarga partida de su esposo de Buffalo, Kelly tiene una confrontación que decide si ella también renunciará. Jeremy comete un error que podría terminar con su carrera en Buffalo. La escasez de gasolina de aviación trae una dosis de realidad aleccionadora a los McBryans. Y después de una visita de su madre, el destino le lanza a Scott una inesperada bola curva.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe pelea una demanda de Transport Canada contra la aerolínea.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La maldición del -40 golpea a los pilotos de Buffalo, Devan y Scott, en un vuelo por correo de alimentos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Mikey va en busca del tesoro a Venezuela en busca de un raro waterbomber CL-215.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un enlace de ferry vital está caído, por lo que Buffalo organiza una campaña total para transportar 100,000 libras de productos.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.sub-title: No Te Metas Con Chuck Adam
programme.desc: El mecánico crujiente Chuck lidera la lucha para preparar a los Electra para una misión de socorro en casos de desastre en Haití.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Los jóvenes pilotos AJ y Andrew tienen la oportunidad de su vida de volar el magnífico DC-3.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Buffalo obtiene la carta de su vida cuando se les pide que transporten la Copa Stanley en una gira por el Norte.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El piloto principal Arnie aterriza el DC-3 en una franja de arena casera en un refugio remoto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando las tormentas eléctricas y un motor tembloroso amenazan un alquiler de DC-3 a Whitehorse.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Mientras entrena a los capitanes de bombas de agua para la próxima temporada de extinción de incendios.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe contrata al forastero Duane Hicks para ayudar a Buffalo a navegar el futuro y entrenar a Mikey.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Buffalo se mete en el negocio de las acrobacias aéreas cuando el veterano piloto Arnie vuela el DC-4.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Crítico de las muchas paradas y arranques en el programa de Electra, y frustrado con el drama constante en Buffalo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.sub-title: Problemas con el Tren de Aterrizaje
programme.desc: Frustrada por su falta de vuelo y atrapada en una rutina como conductora de mensajería.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Duane consigue un contrato enorme para el Electra y ejerce una enorme presión sobre el mecánico Adam.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El Electra vuela a Alert, el asentamiento más al norte de la Tierra, lo que obliga a Adam y al nuevo gerente Duane a resolver las cosas.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Las chispas vuelan cuando Joe descubre que Gord ha aceptado un trabajo con una aerolínea rival.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Tratando de dejar su huella en Buffalo, Duane consigue dos contratos más de Electra.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico Jimmy es enviado a un campamento minero del norte para crear una pista de aterrizaje de hielo en un lago remoto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Problemas de motor en el C-46 durante la carrera en valle obligan a Devan a apagar un motor.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El piloto novato de bombas de agua, Scott, prueba por primera vez la acción cuando Buffalo responde a una llamada de emergencia.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando Yellowknife y la comunidad de aviación del norte se ven sacudidos por tres accidentes en el espacio de un mes...

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe recibe una visita negativa de Transport Canada cuando los inspectores amenazan con cerrar la aerolínea.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de tomar el mando de un puente aéreo intenso y lidiar con la carga de Electra más fea que jamás haya visto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una semana antes de Navidad, Buffalo acepta echar una mano a una iniciativa de la RCMP para llevar juguetes a comunidades aisladas del norte.
